item.title: 对黄金时代的回望，并不只是为了在故人的身上照见也曾理想主义的自己，也不是企图召唤一些已不合时宜的幽灵。
item.description:
对黄金时代的回望，并不只是为了在故人的身上照见也曾理想主义的自己，也不是企图召唤一些已不合时宜的幽灵。

更多时候怀念的是一份纯真，或是一种激情；前者像带着暖意的雪后初阳，后者如同迸发出胸膛的那声高昂的小号。

item.title: https://youtu.be/wvhW8cp15tk?t=1740
item.description:
https://youtu.be/wvhW8cp15tk?t=1740

Jobs: Apple is a software company.

Not sure Apple is loved for their own software. However, Apple did succeeded in defining the design language for the human-machine interface that informed generations of personal digital devices.

Will Claude.md be the next era-defining artifact getting admitted into MoMA? I wonder.

edit: notice Jobs (and Gates) are clear-eyed about future of software in marrying local applications and cloud services.
